title: Christopher Bengtsson — Fullstack software engineer
description: Fullstack software engineering for new features, existing systems, maintenance and automation.
headline: I build software, automate tasks and optimise existing systems.
introduction: I'm Christopher, a fullstack engineer with over nine years of experience across interfaces, backend services, databases, cloud and integrations. I take time to understand business goals and make technical decisions with future development and maintenance in mind.

services.title: What I do
services.intro: I can take responsibility from the initial need through delivery or work as part of your existing team. These are common ways I can help.

capabilities.title: Build and extend
capabilities.description: Build and ship features, internal tools and integrations, including the interface, service and data changes needed to make them work.

capabilities.title: Improve and maintain
capabilities.description: Make existing systems and AI-built apps safer to change through targeted fixes, tests and automated dependency updates.

capabilities.title: Reduce manual work
capabilities.description: Build automation that connects tools and services, replaces repetitive steps and handles failures. Use AI where it adds value.

capabilities.title: Review and advise
capabilities.description: Review a codebase, architecture or technical decision and provide prioritized recommendations with the tradeoffs behind them.

experience.title: Selected work
experience.intro: A few projects from employment and consulting assignments, spanning architecture, implementation and long-term ownership.
experience.note: The organisations named here do not endorse my independent work.

jobs.description: On Evinova's clinical trial platform for patients, study sites and sponsors, I work across React apps and Hapi/NestJS services in an international team. Some services connect the frontend to Spring Boot backends owned by other teams; others handle notification emails through Kafka events or job queues. I also help troubleshoot issues across environments with QA colleagues, and have worked on a backward-compatible login flow and Playwright/Cucumber tests.
With another fullstack developer, I built a KYC flow from React forms through an Express API and Postgres to Salesforce. My work covered validation, data storage and integration between the systems.

My team was responsible for Trustly's microfrontend architecture, developer tooling and UI library. I helped build the Azura checkout and carried out a complete UI and UX refactor of the PayPal top-up site. I worked mainly in React, but also with Spring Boot and Postgres. My work included real-time data and Playwright tests with accessibility checks.

jobs.company: Headlight / Relight · consulting for the Swedish Transport Administration
jobs.description: I worked mainly across several projects for the Swedish Transport Administration. The change-request portal was an ongoing responsibility: I built it from scratch as its sole developer and later focused mainly on maintenance. The work involved a SOAP/XML integration, SQL Server stored procedures and regular contact with business stakeholders.
